tools.name: burn_mint
tools.description: Mint a task-bound disposable agent; 12 canary shards planted. $0.25/cycle, first free once per operator.

tools.name: burn_run
tools.description: Run the bound task with a minted credential.

tools.name: burn_spawn
tools.description: Spawn a child; custody of one spawn-grant shard transfers.

tools.name: burn_burn
tools.description: Burn an agent; signed receipt only when every shard is accounted.

tools.name: burn_verify
tools.description: Verify a burn receipt against the persistent registry.

tools.name: burn_resurface_scan
tools.description: Scan a presented artifact for resurfaced shards; a match revokes standing.

tools.name: burn_gate
tools.description: Requester gate: accept a deliverable only with a verifying receipt.
